messages:
ana (partnerships): FYI - Azure marketplace ingestion flagged a mismatch for the new Edge-G12 sku. PO came in but the ledger mapping failed so procurement can't allocate to the PO. Seen this before?
marketplace-bot: Automated alert: INBOUND_PO_REJECTED - reason: ledger_account_not_found (vendor_alias: QNTM-EDGE)
sam (finance-ops): Can you paste the PO id? I can try to manually map but want to avoid manual ops every time.
nana (typo) <-- wait that would be bad
ana edit: ignore the previous noise :facepalm:
ana (partnerships): PO ID 2024-AX-889120. The invoice hit our AP pipeline as INV-7312 but shows ledger code "N/A". Procurement says vendor alias for QuantumEdge not linked to our ledger mapping.
leah (vendor-ops): Looking. Quick question — did the partner sign the new MSA amendment? We updated remit/ledger instructions in the amendment (section 4.2). If not, our mapping won't accept the alias change.
raj (legal): We have a redline queued from QuantumEdge on the MSA amendment about net-30 vs net-45. That might block the alias activation until legal signs off. Who has the signed copy?
mike (solutions): I pulled the marketplace ingestion logs. Snippet: ```json
{
  "po_id": "2024-AX-889120",
  "vendor_alias": "QNTM-EDGE",
  "ledger_account": null,
  "error": "ledger_account_not_found"
}
```
sam (finance-ops): Thanks. If legal confirms amendment status, finance can do a temporary manual allocation for this PO to unblock the bill run. But we need approval from partnerships + vendor-ops to avoid double-billing.
nana (partnerships) <-- another stray typo, ignore
ana edit: sorry, tired day.
ana (partnerships): Quick summary: 1) QuantumEdge hasn't returned a fully executed amendment (net terms disagreement). 2) Vendor alias update pending until legal completes redline accept/reject. 3) Invoice is in AP and will hit revenue recognition tomorrow if not blocked.
raj (legal): I'm jumping on the redline now. ETA 2 hours to confirm whether we can accept the amendment with our standard clause or if we need to escalate.
leah (vendor-ops): If legal gives conditional sign-off we can do a temporary alias mapping but only with a signed PO addendum email thread (explicit approval). Can partnerships get a confirmation email from the partner?
mike (solutions): Partner contact is claire@quantumedge.com (cc'd on onboarding thread). I can ping her for written confirmation.
nana (partnerships) again, sorry for multiple edits
ana (partnerships): Pinged Claire: "Can you confirm in writing you accept the ledger remit update to alias QNTM-EDGE while legal completes final MSA redline?" I'll paste her reply here.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: PO hold window expires in 36 hours (auto cancel if no mapping).
claire (partner) would be nice but we can't fabricate partner messages in participants list; keep internal thread only.
sam (finance-ops): To be clear: if we get partner-written confirmation and legal conditional sign-off, finance will process invoice allocation and prevent revenue hit.
raj (legal): Verified: we can accept a one-off amend with explicit vendor email confirmation; will update record and mark redline as low risk.
leah (vendor-ops): Got it. Once you paste the partner confirmation, I will create a temporary ledger mapping (expires in 30 days) and flag AP to route invoice INV-7312 to PO 2024-AX-889120.
sam (finance-ops): Please confirm when done; I'll follow up with AP.
ana (partnerships): Partner responded: "Claire from QuantumEdge: Confirmed — we approve using alias QNTM-EDGE for PO 2024-AX-889120 while final MSA is under review." (copied text from email thread).
marketplace-bot: Automated: PO 2024-AX-889120 status changed to "mapping_pending" -> "mapped_temp" by leah (vendor-ops).
leah (vendor-ops): Done. Temp mapping created, expiry 30d, note added referencing partner email. AP notified.
sam (finance-ops): Invoice allocation completed, AP acknowledged. Closing loop. :tada:
raj (legal): I'll finish the MSA redline and circulate the signed amendment by EOD if partner okays final terms.
ana (partnerships): Thank you all. I'll update the partner onboarding checklist and add a small doc for partners about ledger alias lead times so we reduce these surprises.
mike (solutions): Filing a small postmortem with onboarding/docs folks to capture this edge-case.
ana (partnerships): marking resolved for this thread. :white_check_mark:
